projects.description: End-to-end procurement intelligence work combining demand and price forecasting, ETL and feature engineering, model evaluation, supplier allocation, procurement optimization, and reporting. Used five-plus years of transactional and time-series data and reported approximately 95% monthly, 80% weekly, and 75% daily forecasting performance, with approximately 4% monthly procurement cost reduction.
projects.name: Procurement forecasting and optimization

projects.description: Built a retrieval-augmented-generation proof of concept using Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, Cosmos DB, embeddings, semantic search, document chunking, authentication, per-user conversation history, feedback/enrichment, and Streamlit. This was a proof of concept rather than a production deployment; reported Hit Rate@5 was approximately 85% on a curated evaluation set.
projects.name: Generative AI / RAG proof of concept

projects.description: M.Tech thesis involving MILP, Gurobi, vehicle-routing optimization, multi-compartment vehicle routing, and healthcare-waste routing.
projects.name: Efficient Routing of Healthcare Waste Using Multi-Compartment Vehicles

work_experience.description: Worked on an end-to-end procurement intelligence solution using demand and price forecasting, supplier allocation and procurement optimization, data pipelines, ETL, feature engineering, model evaluation, and reporting/dashboarding over five-plus years of transactional and time-series data. AWS data sources included S3 and Athena, with exposure to Lambda, EC2, and EventBridge. Forecasting used ARIMA, SARIMA, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Random Forest, N-BEATS, and NHITS. Optimization used PuLP for supplier allocation and scorecarding.
Worked on optimization and operations-research problems involving MILP, CVRPTW, vehicle compatibility, and capacity and time-window constraints using Python, Gurobi, and OR-Tools.
